caption: The drawing depicts a mechanical device consisting primarily of wood, featuring a large vertical wheel mounted on a wooden frame. The wheel is circular, with several evenly spaced projections around its rim, each ending in a bell-shaped metal component, likely metallic and colored in a dull dark tone such as grey or greenish-grey. The wheel is affixed to a central vertical wooden support that is attached to a rectangular wooden base with two cross beams, providing stability. The entire structure rests on a plain, light-colored background. The image utilizes shades of brown to represent the wooden parts, with darker lines to indicate edges and construction details, and the bells are shaded to suggest metallic material. The composition is centered, with the device taking up the majority of the vertical midsection of the page, leaving ample blank space around it. Near the bottom right side of the device, there is a signature or label reading "W.M. Keckhull."
title: Altar Chimes on Wheel
